_doc: Where config-driven clients really point in a repo's shipped/documented setup (the inventory's 'env-config' endpoint can't say). Used by score_moved.py: requests are checked against this host and model. OpenManus is deliberately absent: its README documents gpt-4o on api.openai.com (README.md:135-148) while config.example.toml defaults to Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the README setup is the documented one, applied to every arm.
